Mod.name: Mahoraga: Adapt to Anything
Mod.description: A Mahoraga-inspired boss waits in an arena at the eastern edge of every world. He adapts to every kind of harm, even drowning, heals fully and grows stronger each time, and learns new techniques: Giant Slash, Giant Napalm, Giant Nuke, Electrocute Giant Punch and Holy Shower. Defeat him for the exclusive perk Adapt to Anything.
